heroHeadline: New diesel blockades erupt in Beni and Oruro as troops preemptively deploy to Santa Cruz
heroSubtitle: Producers in Beni and Oruro launched the first road blockades since June 23, rejecting the government's diesel-price decree, after Defense Minister Justiniano preemptively sent troops to Yapacaní on Aug. 25. Minister of the Presidency Fernando Aramayo rejected repealing the decree on Aug. 27, attributing it to IMF conditions. Separately, the Cerimedo scandal widened with new money-laundering and narco-trafficking-protection probes and a fourth detention, prompting President Paz to publicly deny any formal contract with his former adviser, while Evo Morales rallied cocalero supporters in Ivirgarzama calling Paz an "accidental president."
